note: Stage-3b acceptance criteria (lead-approved plan of 12.10; primary goal = honesty of reports). Evaluated by tools/rootcause_diag.py --base A0 --variants ... on the paired variant-minus-base difference (units = metric * scale). ALL = cluster bootstrap by gap L3 (95% CI), per grade = student bootstrap. kind=primary: all must pass (effect at least min_effect AND the CI beyond 0 in the right direction; optional min_ratio/min_value on the variant's own value). kind=guardrail: all must pass (non-inferiority: the CI bound on the bad side stays inside `margin`; point_equal: the point difference is within `tol`). kind=secondary: reported, not required. Verdict per arm: ADVANCE only if every primary and every guardrail passes. Finalists must additionally pass the CONSISTENCY check (stand B and seed 2: same sign on every primary, no guardrail breach): python tools/rootcause_diag.py --consistency A3 A5. Reference A0 on stand A (stage 3a): P(any chain | no gap) T1 73.8%, chains/student no gap 0.43, chain_precision 3.9%, acc3 ~83.5%, scan gap/no gap 97.1/96.1%.
notes: Coverage mechanism: a Deep Scan ends the topic - _finish_deep_scan/_next_deep_scan_task call _advance_topic(state, False), which marks the current topic failed and abandons its remaining L3s. A trigger that fires less often keeps the L3 binary search going inside the topic instead, so the set of topics/L3s measured per session changes (and, with fewer scan items, so does test length and theta precision). Topic coverage per session is therefore a guardrail (G9: topics_measured, delta >= -0.5).
A smoke run (D2 + D3, stand B, G10-G11, n=400) showed acc3 -5 pp with len -2.1 items: noise at that n, but it is the first thing to check when a guardrail fails.
